svg.title: Figure 12.5 — Clustering and Thermoregulation
svg.desc: Cold-weather cluster contrasted with warm-weather ventilation, fanning and evaporative cooling.
svg.text: Honey bee colonies regulate nest temperature collectively; the strategy changes with heat load and season.
dense outer mantle + warmer brood/core region
Bearding alone is not proof of dangerous overheating; interpret it with temperature, ventilation, hive condition and colony behaviour.
